label: Altitude
value: About 2,300 m at Utror proper, rising to about 2,900 m at Kundol Lake
quote: The altitude of the valley at Utror proper is 2,300 metres (7,500 ft) and reaches 2,900 metres (9,500 ft) at Kundol Lake.

label: Distance
value: 16 km from Kalam Valley, 116 km from Saidu Sharif
quote: Utror is 16 km (9.9 mi) away from Kalam Valley and 116 km (72 mi) from Saidu Sharif.

label: Position
value: Kalam lies to the south, Gabral to the north, Bhan valley to the east
quote: Utror is surrounded by Bhan valley on the east, Upper Dir District on the west, Kalam on the south and Gabral on the north.

label: Kundol Lake
value: In the north of the Utror region, 19 km from Kalam
quote: Another notable lake in the Kalam Valley is the Kundol Lake, located in the north of Utror region, 19 km away from Kalam.

label: Winter
value: Upper areas of the Swat region are colder and often get snow in winter
quote: The upper areas of the region are relatively colder and often get snowfall in the winter.
